title: RadAG: Reward-Adversarial Attention Guidance for Efficient Inference-Time Alignment of Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28809v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion and flow-based models have achieved remarkable success in generation, yet their samples often remain suboptimal in fidelity and text alignment. Two lines of inference-time methods address this: extrapolation guidance, such as classifier-free guidance (CFG) and its variants, and reward guidance, which aligns samples with reward models of human preference. Extrapolation guidance needs only forward passes, but it builds its reference by heuristic rules unrelated to the reward and therefore cannot steer sampling toward a given reward. Gradient-based reward guidance steers sampling directly toward a higher reward, but backpropagates through the entire generator at every step. This trade-off raises the question of whether extrapolation guidance can steer sampling toward a higher reward without a full backward pass. translated_title: RadAG：用于扩散模型高效推理时对齐的奖励-对抗注意力引导方法
translated_abstract: 扩散模型和基于流的模型在生成任务中取得了显著成功，但它们的样本在保真度和文本对齐方面往往仍不够理想。现有两类推理时方法可以解决这一问题：一类是外推引导，如无分类器引导（CFG）及其变体；另一类是奖励引导，即将样本与基于人类偏好的奖励模型进行对齐。外推引导只需要前向传播即可完成，但它通过启发式规则构建参考，这些规则与奖励无关，因此无法将采样过程引导至给定奖励的方向。基于梯度的奖励引导可以直接将采样引向更高的奖励，但每一步都需要对整个生成器进行反向传播。这种权衡引出了一个关键问题：外推引导能否在不进行完整反向传播的情况下将采样引导至更高奖励？为回答这一问题，我们提出了奖励-对抗注意力引导，通过扰动构建参考……
tldr: 提出RadAG方法，利用奖励-对抗注意力扰动构建引导参考，使外推引导无需完整的反向传播即可将扩散模型的采样导向更高的奖励，从而实现高效的推理时对齐。
en_tdlr: RadAG leverages reward-adversarial attention perturbations to construct guidance references, enabling extrapolation guidance to steer diffusion model sampling toward higher rewards without full backpropagation, achieving efficient inference-time alignment.
